description: This file provides Unix socket credential handling functions for the ttrpc package, including credential retrieval, validation, and socket requirement checks.

methods.name: Handshake
methods.description: Performs a handshake to retrieve and validate Unix socket peer credentials.

methods.name: UnixSocketRequireUidGid
methods.description: Returns a function that validates Unix socket peer credentials against specified UID and GID.

methods.name: UnixSocketRequireRoot
methods.description: Returns a function that requires the peer to have root privileges (UID 0, GID 0).

methods.name: UnixSocketRequireSameUser
methods.description: Returns a function that validates incoming connections against the current effective user and group.
